videos.title: Two Arches and One Quiet Landing #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A small basin and a moving stream establish a recognizable fountain; the first angle change is visible before explanatory formulas.
editorial.mechanism: Two complementary parabolas share an endpoint. A final turn to forty-five degrees visibly extends the landing point, then leaves the stream flowing.
editorial.readability: Range markers were moved below the basin; the same-distance label disappears when the condition changes. The ideal model and slowed presentation are identified.
editorial.pacing: The final condition is explained and shown before the closing sentence. The flowing stream remains a subject-relevant motion during the final hold.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused pulley checks did not repeat the duplicated words in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The basin is schematic, and the sparse drop stream may read as a dotted path. Symbols v, g and theta rely on the narration and familiar notation rather than an explicit legend. No aesthetic preference or continuous audiovisual response was measured.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Light Shared Between Nine Small Squares #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A recognizable lantern and moving screen introduce spreading before the square grid appears.
editorial.mechanism: A side-view light bundle maps to a separately labeled front-view patch. The final distance of three creates nine cells, then returning close concentrates the same modeled power.
editorial.readability: Labels distinguish the two views and identify shading as an energy encoding. Clear-space and tiny-source assumptions are stated.
editorial.pacing: The third-distance consequence and return happen within the final section; the final square becomes visibly smaller and darker.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused pulley checks did not repeat the duplicated words in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The lamp remains a small icon. The link between the side-view segment and front-view square still depends on narration. Animated opacity is not a simulation of visual brightness. Sound is dry narration, with no subjective listening review.

videos.title: A Steady Pour and an Unsteady Rise #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A cone-shaped glass vessel and continuous constant-volume pour make its changing rise visible.
editorial.mechanism: Half height is compared to one eighth capacity; the final comparison uses a cylinder with equal height and total capacity and the same inflow.
editorial.readability: Water levels and their percentages are attached to the appropriate vessels. The conical and cylindrical geometry was independently checked.
editorial.pacing: The opening pour was changed to a renderer clock so it continues through narration. The comparison animation fits its measured cue, then the unequal heights remain available for inspection.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused pulley checks did not repeat the duplicated words in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The initial vessel can resemble a stylized glass more than an everyday bowl. Cross-sectional drawings do not directly display all three-dimensional volume. The last comparison still holds for several seconds, and no audience transfer was measured.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Longer Journey That Makes a Basket Lighter #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A planted hanging basket stays attached to its moving wheel and continuous rope.
editorial.mechanism: Rope length conservation gives the two-to-one movement ratio. The last smaller pull visibly halves the load's rise without changing that ratio.
editorial.readability: The anchor gap was repaired. Force and distance labels accompany separate stages, and the one-moving-wheel geometry pulls the free end upward.
editorial.pacing: The second lift begins in the final section, resolves, then holds the displacement comparison. Focused ASR did not reproduce two apparent repetitions in the full-file transcript.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused pulley checks did not repeat the duplicated words in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The basket and plant are simple silhouettes, and the grip is an abstract handle rather than a hand. The ending returns to a largely static diagram after the smaller lift. This is an ideal quasistatic demonstration, not a realistic simulation of effort or acceleration.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Invisible Balance in a Falling Leaf #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A veined leaf descends before the force explanation, making the invisible interaction concrete.
editorial.mechanism: Quadratic drag grows toward weight in a labeled force diagram. Two final leaves share one slowed clock and gravity, while only one trajectory includes drag.
editorial.readability: The frozen explanation is explicitly labeled as a force diagram. The moving comparison identifies air and no-air conditions; flutter is excluded.
editorial.pacing: The final trajectories continue during the closing narration rather than freezing between cues. The final positional separation follows the independently checked solutions.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; focused pulley checks did not repeat the duplicated words in full-file ASR. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: A real leaf's flutter and changing drag are absent; its shape is a clean icon. The force diagram occupies much of the middle, and terminal speed is explained more than it is numerically quantified. Sampled inspection cannot establish felt calm or prosody.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.
